name: Iron Reapers
headerMeta: Golden era · Dual-weapon melee · Blob/flank · 270 leadership · T5
pitch: A burst-damage blob monster with a 12-second CC-immune window and heavy-armour passive that resets via abilities, enabling sustained fights in formation. Weakness: units that kite or apply debuffs burst you before the passive cycles.

doctrines.name: Movement Speed After Hit
doctrines.note: 20–30% of fight time is walking to next target

veterancy.label: Middle-line focus
veterancy.body: +14 points Middle Line (until reaching the Line point that grants +1 target per strike), rest into Bottom Line for sustained duration.

battleRole.positioning: Engage as a wedge in formation; X-move in and wait for heavy-armour passive to trigger (8-hit bonus per model). {1} Pair with your hero to maintain melee contact and chain ability resets. {1}
battleRole.formation: Dispersed formation when engaging multiple targets; tight formation (stacking) when penetrating tower-shield tanks like Imperial Spear Guards, paired with Tiger Step's 12-second CC immunity. {2}
battleRole.tips: Tiger Step grants crowd-control immunity and weapon-swap immunity — use it offensively to commit or defensively to extract from a cavalry charge. {2} Charge has two swings and ignores block; hold off Tiger Step activation for half a second after contact to let both hits land. {2} C-cancel (follow command) resets the heavy-armour passive and auto-attack animation — train this for better trading vs Stalwart or Claymore. {1}

cards.name: Queen's Knights
cards.why: kite-heavy burst outdamages your passive cycling

cards.name: Yorkist Household Knights
cards.why: heavy burst exceeds passive mitigation window

cards.name: Sunward Phalanx
cards.why: big-range kite unit if they space well

cards.name: Stalwart Spearmen
cards.why: block-heavy unit requiring close-range commit that ties up the passive window

cards.name: Spartan Chosen
cards.why: insane damage to heavy block units — commit with hero to force break

cards.name: Imperial Spear Guards
cards.why: tight-formation stack + Tiger Step penetrates flat-DR towers

matchups.pressure: You pressure: any block unit (shield-wall archetype); heavy burst target priority in Blade meta — high-priority doctrine allocation per house guidance {3}.

controls.notes: Charge (twice swings, ignores block) → Weapon Swap (swords for AoE, flails for single-target) → Tiger Step (CC immunity, 12s duration, enables weapon-swap mid-ability) → sustain with C-cancel resets of heavy-armour passive. {2} Spread dispersed to hit 8 models with swords; stack tight + Charge only (no swap) to break Imperial Spear Guard towers via CC immunity. {2} Heavy trait passive: 8-hit bonus damage reduction, reset by Charge or Tiger Step. {1}
